title: P-256 sigma rho: a 2^24-adder walk, concentrated two-cycle cost and an optimised residual Markov reserve

claims.statement: For uniform full-size P-256 targets Q=[x]P, the classical cold algorithm specified in proof.md and the included predecessor specification recovers x with probability at least 0.39 under the explicitly retained H1, M1/L-ori/global fresh-class exposure and H3 premises. All preprocessing, failures, restarts, memory transfers, lookup, replay, verification and output are charged. The total computation is at most 2^127.233072 target-group-operation equivalents at C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions per unit. The walk uses A=2^24 adders, K=2^32 walk slots, distinguished points of probability 2^-60, tau=494321/1000000 and eta=2^-16. At A=2^24 the fresh-source two-cycle rate is 1/(2A)=2^-25, the longer-entry rate is at most 3/(4A^2)+2/A^3=2.664536e-15, charged, the conditional entry bound is P'=64/(2A)=2^-19 and epsilon=10/A+288/A^2+768/A^3; the adder table's construction is charged A*START instructions and its storage A*2*64 bytes. Fresh-source two-cycle entries are separated with an adapted Chernoff bound, and residual rare work carries a Markov reserve whose factor 2^18 multiplies the residual expectation, the sum of a longer-entry part that falls more than 65,538.65-fold (over 2^16-fold) as A grows 2^8-fold, a false-filter part and a merged-step part that do not depend on A; that expectation is 4.87164e-4, 1.90299e-6 and 7.51340e-9 at A=2^16, 2^20 and 2^24, so the total falls more than 64,839-fold but less than 2^16-fold. The common batched path is charged by its anchor schedule: the measured plain round at every step and the measured anchor-round excess only in the batch rounds divisible by 64, a deterministic count. The compiled step depends on A only through mask and shift immediates of the same instruction form, argued at source level. Peak memory is at most 2^77 bytes (2^76.491761 computed), preprocessing is at most 2^50 units (2^49.966808 computed) and is included, and nonuniform advice is zero bytes. The probability calculation is conditional on the disclosed heuristics and the arithmetic pricing on H3; these are not certified at production trajectory lengths. Historical evidence is attributed and its measured scope retained.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the revised full production cost ledger and order certificate, then run the inherited complete reduced-order procedure at tau=0.4943, the production value on its 0.0001 grid, retaining failures and replay checks. The two results have distinct scopes; neither establishes production mixing.
